title: High-voltage connectors and cable assemblies
plain: This factory makes detachable electrical joints between an EV battery, its DC power-distribution system and the input of its power controller. Its first product combines a sealed connector with a short heavy-duty cable.
analogy: A rugged plug and socket for the much larger electrical loads inside an electric vehicle.
product: A licensed two-pole connector pair, panel receptacle and customer-specific cable jumper, supplied with serialised inspection records.
does: Allows high-current equipment to be assembled and serviced while keeping the connection insulated, sealed and mechanically secure.
customers: Electric bus, truck and specialist vehicle manufacturers
Tier-1 harness suppliers buying a qualified connector family
whyNow: Established suppliers offer shielded HV connectors with interlock circuits for batteries, inverters and power distribution [CON1]. Indian manufacturing already exists [CON5]; the opportunity is a buyer-approved alternative for particular imported part numbers, with local engineering and shorter replenishment.
firstProduct: One two-pole, shielded, sealed connector platform with a high-voltage interlock, targeting up to 1,000 V DC and roughly 150–250 A. These are development targets: the released rating must follow cable size, ambient-temperature derating and qualification.
notIncluded: CCS vehicle charging inlets, signal/data connectors, relays, switches, complete vehicle wiring looms and in-house electroplating. The licence must cover the exact chosen design; catalogue examples are not permission to copy it.
entry: Recruit a connector design/process leader and license a proven platform, including drawings, material specifications, crimp tooling and qualification support. Secure one customer programme before ordering production moulds. Make insulating inserts and turned contacts locally; purchase approved spring contacts initially and outsource plating.
capacity: Planning case: 50,000 connector-and-jumper sets annually at maturity, one eight-hour shift over 250 working days. The target is 200 sets per day; customer variants and test time determine actual output.

budget.basis: INR crore, 2026 pre-feasibility planning allowances for a leased industrial shell. Land purchase, new building construction and recoverable GST excluded. No subsidy deducted; working capital separate.

title: Battery-pack production test machines
plain: This factory builds the machines that check a battery pack before it leaves its production line. It sells an engineered test station, its software and ongoing service.
analogy: A factory checkout desk that verifies a battery's identity, electrical health and assembly before dispatch.
product: A modular end-of-line test station with a guarded fixture, electrical instruments, battery communication software, leak-test option and traceable results.
does: Helps a battery manufacturer catch assembly faults, document each shipped pack and change test recipes as products evolve.
customers: Production-line integrators needing an Indian test-station partner
whyNow: Ador Digatron already offers modular battery-pack EOL testing in India [TST1], and Chroma publishes a configurable production-test platform [TST2]. This validates a real equipment category and existing competition. A new supplier must win on a defined pack programme, integration capability, delivery and service.
firstProduct: One configurable 200–800 V battery-pack EOL platform, with a roughly 60 kW bidirectional test-power option, BMS communication, insulation/withstand testing and customer-specified leak testing. Voltage, current and throughput remain engineering targets for the selected pack.
notIncluded: Battery manufacturing, destructive abuse testing, complete cell formation plants, accredited battery certification services and production of the power semiconductor instruments inside the station.
entry: Hire an experienced automation/test lead and collaborate with an established instrument supplier. Own the station architecture, fixtures, electrical panels, test sequencing, traceability and service. Purchase calibrated power stages and measurement instruments; outsource sheet-metal and precision fixture manufacture initially.
capacity: Planning case: 24 stations per year after ramp-up, one shift, two parallel assembly/commissioning bays. This is a project-delivery assumption, not an order forecast or battery-testing throughput.

title: Multilayer and entry-HDI printed circuit boards
plain: This factory makes the bare boards on which electronic components are later mounted. Copper tracks and small plated holes connect several layers inside each board.
analogy: A multilayer road network for electrical signals, with tiny vertical connections between the floors.
product: Customer-designed, electrically tested 8–12-layer rigid boards, including one sequential HDI build-up where needed.
does: Gives electronics manufacturers a qualified Indian source for compact, controlled-impedance boards and local support when designs change.
customers: EMS companies purchasing customer-approved bare boards
Power and embedded-system OEMs needing multilayer boards
whyNow: Equipment and chemistry suppliers support integrated HDI manufacturing [PCB1–PCB3]. AT&S reports continuing HDI qualification at Nanjangud [PCB5], demonstrating a Karnataka manufacturing base. This is a selective replacement of imported board designs, not proof that every advanced board is imported or that all AI server boards fit this line.
firstProduct: 8–12-layer rigid controlled-impedance PCBs, with an optional 1+N+1 construction: one additional fine-interconnect layer on each side of a multilayer core. Start with industrial, telecom and server auxiliary/interface applications on a small set of approved materials.
notIncluded: IC package substrates, ABF or glass-core substrates, flagship GPU baseboards requiring substantially higher layer counts, any-layer smartphone HDI, flexible boards and component assembly. Expanding to those products requires another capability and investment assessment.
entry: Form a technical partnership with an experienced bare-PCB operator, not only an equipment seller. Transfer stack-up design, chemical control, yield improvement and customer qualification methods. Secure several repeat board programmes before freezing line capacity.
capacity: Planning case: approximately 4,000 square metres of saleable finished boards per month at maturity, two shifts over roughly 250 production days yearly. Panel utilisation, layer count, product mix and yield determine the true output.

title: Silicon-carbide power module packaging
plain: This factory turns purchased silicon-carbide chips into robust power-switching modules. The module is then fitted inside a charger, inverter or other power converter.
analogy: The chips are the working engines; the module provides their electrical connections, insulation and route for heat to escape.
product: A qualified 1,200 V half-bridge power-module family, with application data, serialised production test results and agreed reliability evidence.
does: Helps converter manufacturers switch electrical power efficiently in a package they can mount, cool and integrate.
customers: Automotive inverter suppliers after separate automotive qualification
whyNow: L&T Semiconductor Technologies and Newen announced an April 2026 agreement covering development, qualification and supply of SiC modules for renewable converters [SIC1]. It establishes a concrete Indian customer-development route, not proof that a new supplier has orders or that the announced programme is already in volume production.
firstProduct: A licensed 1,200 V half-bridge module using purchased known-good SiC dies, a ceramic copper substrate, silver-sinter die attachment and heavy aluminium wire bonds. Target roughly 100–200 A only after thermal and electrical qualification. Start with one industrial/charger customer.
notIncluded: SiC crystal growth, wafer fabrication, die design, wafer dicing, a complete inverter, GPU packaging and guaranteed automotive approval. Initial incoming material is singulated, traceable die suitable for the licensed package process.
entry: Use a technical JV or licence with an experienced power-module packaging team. Require package design rights, a compatible die source, qualified material set, process recipes, resident launch engineers and joint customer validation. Equipment procurement alone is insufficient.
capacity: Planning case: 24,000 saleable modules annually at maturity, one shift over 250 working days, approximately 96 modules/day. Bond count, package variants, yield and test time determine usable capacity.
